findings.detail: Inherited GPLv2 fonts with explicit font exception; against owner policy. Direct 1.07.4 original archive comparison not obtained; exact licensed mapping independently supported by font names and Mozilla release metadata.
Adobe AFM conditions after conversion, svgtopdf credit, full build/ancestry not verified. Exact npm byte match does not clear the combined bundle.

Listed family licenses are evidenced; exact third-party build/linker/compiler inputs, generated runtime terms and complete attribution have not been independently established. Worker attribution uses companion unminified build map; no reproducible minified build.
CC0-1.0 is evidenced at exact original revision but is not named in plan section 2.1; no policy clearance inferred.
